registry_scope: Partially populated. The Tier 2B intake ticket (plans/dev_graph_demo_tickets.md, branch dev_graph_demo) registers the three sources for topic HORIZON-CL6-2027-01-BIODIV-01, which is what that ticket adds and cites. Tier 1, Tier 2A and the remaining Tier 2B work programmes are unregistered and are the scope of their own tickets. CLAUDE.md §9.6 requires the registry to reflect repository state; this entry records how far it does, so a reader is not misled into treating an absent path as an absent document.
entry_schema: Required on every entry: document_id, path (repo-relative POSIX), tier, media_type, bytes, sha256, digest_basis, title, role, retrieved_on, registered_by. Optional: retrieved_from (absent when the document predates this branch and its retrieval is unrecorded), pages (paginated documents only). bytes and sha256 are measured on the digest_basis, not on the raw file: raw_bytes for a binary document, lf_normalised_bytes for a text one. Text documents are normalised because core.autocrlf is true in this repository, so a text file checks out CRLF on Windows and LF elsewhere, and a raw digest would identify the platform rather than the content.
